questions.q_en:
Read the following information carefully and answer the question that follow:

Gagan has more bags than Ramesh. Pari has more bags than exactly two people. Tanuj has less bags than Ramesh but more than Anu. Who has the second highest number of bags?
questions.solution_en:
We have:

Gagan has more bags than Ramesh. Pari has more bags than exactly two people. Tanuj has less bags than Ramesh but more than Anu.

Gagan > Ramesh > Pari > Tanuj > Anu

So, Ramesh has second highest number of bags.

questions.q_en: If 31 January 2009 was a Saturday, then what was the day of the week on 30 January 2013?
questions.solution_en:
As we know every year on the same date there is the next weekday but in a leap year there are two days next weekday.

So,

31 January 2009 was a Saturday

31 January 2010 was a Sunday

31 January 2011 was a Monday

31 January 2012 was a Tuesday

31 January 2013 was a Thursday

So, 30th January 2013 will be Wednesday.
